Lean.isAuxRecursor.fullDefinition: def isAuxRecursor (env : Environment) (declName : Name) : Bool :=   auxRecExt.isTagged env declName   -- TODO: use `markAuxRecursor` when they are defined   -- An attribute is not a good solution since we don't want users to control what is tagged as an auxiliary recursor.   || declName == ``Eq.ndrec   || declName == ``Eq.ndrecOn
Lean.isAuxRecursor.description: A function that checks if a given declaration in a specified environment is an auxiliary recursor.

Lean.isNoConfusion.fullDefinition: def isNoConfusion (env : Environment) (n : Name) : Bool :=   noConfusionExt.isTagged env n
Lean.isNoConfusion.description: A function that determines if a specified declaration in an environment is associated with the no-confusion property.

Lean.mkRecOnName.fullDefinition: def mkRecOnName (indDeclName : Name) : Name   := Name.mkStr indDeclName recOnSuffix def mkBRecOnName (indDeclName : Name) : Name  := Name.mkStr indDeclName brecOnSuffix def mkBInductionOnName (indDeclName : Name) : Name  := Name.mkStr indDeclName binductionOnSuffix def mkBelowName (indDeclName : Name) : Name := Name.mkStr indDeclName belowSuffix def mkIBelowName (indDeclName : Name) : Name := Name.mkStr indDeclName ibelowSuffix
Lean.mkRecOnName.description: A function that creates a recursive structure based on the specified inductive declaration name.

Lean.mkBRecOnName.fullDefinition: def mkBRecOnName (indDeclName : Name) : Name  := Name.mkStr indDeclName brecOnSuffix def mkBInductionOnName (indDeclName : Name) : Name  := Name.mkStr indDeclName binductionOnSuffix def mkBelowName (indDeclName : Name) : Name := Name.mkStr indDeclName belowSuffix def mkIBelowName (indDeclName : Name) : Name := Name.mkStr indDeclName ibelowSuffix
Lean.mkBRecOnName.description: A function that generates a name for a bounded recursion operation based on the specified inductive declaration name.
